borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Proposed Site Plan - drawing no.9HA -PL -02 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Ground Floor Plan - drawing no.9HA -PL -03 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed First Floor Plan Copy 1 - drawing no.9HA -PL -04&nbsp;- dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Loft Floor Plan - drawing no.9HA -PL -05 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Roof Plan - drawing no.9HA -PL -06 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Front Elevation - drawing no.9HA -PL -07 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Rear Elevation - drawing no.9HA -PL -08 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Left Elevation - drawing no.9HA -PL -09 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Right Elevation - drawing no.9HA -PL -10 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Section A-A - drawing no.9HA -PL -11 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Section B-B - drawing no.9HA -PL -12 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Outbuilding Floor Plan - drawing no.9HA -PL -13 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed Outbuilding Roof Plan - drawing no.9HA -PL -14 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Proposed Outbuilding Elevation &amp; Section - drawing no.9HA -PL -15 - dated 13.01.2025</li><li>Existing &amp; Proposed 3D - drawing no.9HA -PL -16 - dated 13.01.2025</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

<p>The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied or used at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 340 Heathway and as shown on the plans hereby approved.</p>
description: Demolition of existing outbuilding and construction of a single storey outbuilding, the construction of a two storey side extension and a single storey rear extension and a roof extension including a roof light to the front to facilitate the conversion of loft space to habitable use
